headline: Snip, Compare and a new Export
summary: Grab part of the screen from any app, compare two images, and export a board as a web page or a PDF.

new.title: Snip to board
new.description: Press Ctrl+Alt+S in any app and drag a box. The snip lands on your board.
new.note: You can change the shortcut or turn it off in Settings › Shortcuts.
new.details: Click instead of dragging to grab a whole display, and press Esc to cancel. Snips taken one after another line up in a row, each named after the window it came from.

new.title: Compare
new.description: Lay two images over each other with a wipe, onion skin or difference view.
new.where: Selection bar, with two images selected
new.details: Drag B or use the arrow keys to line it up. W, O and D switch views, X swaps the images, and Esc closes.

new.title: Export to a web page or PDF
new.description: One Export dialog on Ctrl+E. A board can now go out as a viewer page or a PDF.
new.where: Ctrl+E, or Export in the toolbar
new.details: The viewer is one .html file that opens in any browser, on a computer or a phone, with pan, zoom and a label filter. Cropped images are exported as cropped.

new.title: What's New, shorter
new.description: Updates show a short card on Home, and new buttons wear a New badge until you try them.

improved.title: Settings
improved.description: Search every setting and shortcut, or press a key to see what it does.

improved.title: Smoother zoom
improved.description: Zooming into large images no longer stutters.

improved.title: Tidier selection bar
improved.description: Its tools sit in groups: Arrange, Line up rows and Match size.

improved.title: Drawing
improved.description: Picking Pen or Eraser turns drawing on, so the separate Draw button is gone.

improved.title: Leaner left toolbar
improved.description: Paste, Save, Open and Fit view left the toolbar. Their shortcuts still work.

improved.title: Lighter shadows
improved.description: Menus and text notes cast softer shadows.

fixed.title: Locked groups stay put
fixed.description: Arrange in a row or a column no longer moves a locked group.

fixed.title: Smooth pen strokes
fixed.description: Strokes no longer look beaded, or draw a stray line when the pen comes back in.
